name: app-wellness-tracker-phone-on-violet-and-yellow-planes
title: Medication adherence app on periwinkle with yellow accent, standing on a textured slope
whatItIs: A periwinkle phone tilts on a lavender textured slope against vertical colour planes in navy, indigo, yellow and white. The screen shows a wellness tracker with yellow segmented tabs, a white card with a donut chart (54%) and three status pills, and a yellow plus button in the nav.
whatItMeans: Friendly, clear and optimistic; blue with a sunny yellow accent softens a medical topic.
techniques: Colour the whole UI in one hue with one yellow accent.
Stage the device against flat colour planes that match the UI.
Use a soft donut chart with status pills.
Place a shadow-casting phone on a textured surface.

vocabulary.definition: Flat vertical blocks of colour used as a backdrop.
A ring chart showing a proportion.
A single contrasting colour used sparingly.
A tilted surface with grainy texture.
